description: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no. 7 (refuse and recycling storage) pursuant to planning permission reference 182956FUL dated 20/03/2020 for 'Third and fourth floor level side extensions to provide twenty-seven addition hotel rooms; installation of single air conditioning unit at roof level; alteration to rear fenestration of building involving installation of door to refuse store; and associated cycle and waste storage spaces'. Amendment seeks to amend condition 7 to remove the requirement for refuse and recycling storage to be provided in accordance with drawing PA/937/200, and instead allow refuse and recycling arising from the development to be managed through an existing private waste collection arrangement as amended by application 242403VAR dated 27.02.2026 for Application for a Minor Material Amendment (S73.a) to vary conditions 2 and 6 of planning permission ref: 182956FUL dated 20/03/2020 for: Third and fourth floor level side extensions to provide twenty-seven addition hotel rooms; installation of single air conditioning unit at roof level; alteration to rear fenestration of building involving installation of door to refuse store; and associated cycle and waste storage spaces.
